MASTER CALENDAR JURY
Off Calendar Aug-29-2005 Assigned To Trial Court

COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar Aug-29-2005 Vacated
MINI MINUTES: This matter came regularly on calendar this day, by assignment from the Department of the Presiding Judge for Settlement on the record.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Joe Vickstein.
Matthew Wertheim, Esq. for Plaintiff: David Fong, also present.
Defendant: Victoria Fay, present in pro per.
Case settled, terms read into the record as follows:
Parties stipulated for a Judgment of $13,200.00 for restiution and possession of the premises located at 853 Greenwich St., San Francisco, stayed until Oct. 1, 2005
Defendant agreed to vacate by Sept. 30, 2005, and Plaintiff to waived back-rent and damages.
If Defendant failed to vacate as agreed, Judgment for Plaintiff in the amount of $13,200.00 plus fees and costs.
Parties agreed to terms, matter is deemed settled, Trial vacated.
Counsel to prepare Judgment.

Sept. 1, 2005
Judgment signed by Comm. Kaplan
